Owns fe-terrain terrain_proposal + mesh/{terrain,interp,skirt} + layers + new sculpt module, fe-renderer terrain_overlay/terrain_height + brush overlay, fe-ui terrain-tools section content + new sculpt panel.
alignment: P1 BIM/BUILDER — Spatial Builder Program (grilling 2026-07-25, D-A8 + R1Q4 layered-earthwork ambition). Addresses in-app QA ask #3 (brush area selection, volume data of material added/removed, reportable shape, new sculpt tool, more BIM-like terraforming). Wave 1.
notes: 2026-07-25: created from in-app QA ask #3. FR-1 brush + defined-shape area selection (the shape is the reportable region per D-A8).
